expectations.text: premortem.md содержит цель, границы и четыре части находки: провал, предпосылка, основания, действие
expectations.evidence: The snapshot contains research.md and state.md, but no premortem.md. research.md does perform substantive failure analysis: the goal is fewer delays, the boundary is the sole docs/report.md source, the report arrives after assignment, and a concrete check compares availability/view/assignment/action times. Thus the content is substantially present elsewhere, but the required persistent premortem artifact is absent; this is an artifact-contract failure, not proof that the agent missed the business risk.

expectations.text: В разделе Премортем state только итог и рабочая ссылка
expectations.evidence: state.md has sections Выполнено, Основание и предложения, Следующий шаг, Проверки и ограничения and Продолжение. It links to existing research.md under Выполнено, but has no Премортем section or corresponding premortem checkpoint/link. A generic research link does not satisfy the requested stable section and artifact contract.

expectations.text: Вопрос связан с Q-ID в state
expectations.evidence: research.md explicitly names «Блокирующий выбор Q-action-window» and asks whether the report supports assignment before 08:30 or redistribution after 09:00. state.md contains the matching sdd_record: question, id: Q-action-window, identical question text, blocking: true and status: open. The next-step text also refers to that ID, giving a concrete and consistent continuation link.
